versions.content: Basic Software Resources and RTE Resources Type: valid Description: The System Template has to cover resource requests of the basic SW and the RTE. Rationale: Resources of an ECU are, by their own definition, limited (RAM, ROM, CPU time, etc.). Such limitations act as constraints during the mapping process. Dependencies: None identified. Use Case: Taking into account memory limitations when allocating AUTOSAR services and features on a small ECU. Supporting Material: –
